changelog.body:
Added more debug logging
Added better compatibility detection

* Added a lot of new icons including `AT&T`'s `5G` icons 
* Added a color selector
* Some stability enhancements

- Added tons of icons from older Android versions
- Added 3 custom icons
- Made the UI a lot better
- Allow use of the systems icons as replacements
- Fixed some bugs with the icon selector

Version 2 is here and it comes with huge improvements!
`Fake5GIcon` has been renamed to `MobileDataChanger`!

- You can now replace any mobile data icon with any mobile data icon. So many possibilities!
- You can now use the app on any Android `>=8.1`.

I recommend you reading the README for installation and usage instructions.
Also the package name changed, so please uninstall the old module beforehand.

This is the first version of Fake5GIcon.
It will replace the 4G icon with the 5G icon. 
For this it uses the system icons.
As they added the 5G icon in android 10, this only works on android 10 and higher.
If you only want to replace the 4G icon with the 5G icon and have android 10 or higher, this module will do nicely, as it's only 170KB in size.

# [MobileIconChanger](https://github.com/programminghoch10/MobileIconChanger)
Change your mobile data icons! For example you can change the 3G/4G icons into 5G!

This module enables you to replace any of the mobile data icons with any other mobile data icon.

## Compatibility

Any AOSP near ROM should be compatible. Just try it out and see if it works. 

[Read more about compatiblity here](https://github.com/programminghoch10/MobileIconChanger#compatibility).

## Installation

1. Install the module on a system with a running XPosed framework with API version `>=93`.
1. **Activate the resource hooks** within your XPosed framework manager.
1. Activate the module. The package `SystemUI` should automatically be selected.
1. Restart your phone.
1. You are now ready to use the module. You will need to open the [Configuration](#configuration) screen to set it all up, as the module won't do anything yet.

## Configuration

_I don't like it when every XPosed module adds yet another app icon to the launcher. This is why this modules settings are hidden within the App-Info screen._

Here is how to open the settings:

- Route 1:
    - Go to the module list within your XPosed manager
    - Long press on `CameraControl` and select App Info
    - On the bottom, click on `Advanced`
    - Click on `Additional settings in the app`
- Route 2:
    - Go into device settings
    - Click on apps
    - Somehow tell the device to show all apps
    - Select `CameraControl`
    - On the bottom, click on `Advanced`
    - Click on `Additional settings in the app`
- Route 3:
    - Open up an ADB shell
    - Run command `am start-activity com.programminghoch10.mobileiconchanger/.SettingsActivity`

## More resources

I don't want to keep 4 different places up to date.

If you want to read more about 
[why this module exists](https://github.com/programminghoch10/MobileIconChanger#inspiration)
or [additional info about the configuration interface](https://github.com/programminghoch10/MobileIconChanger#configuration)
or [you just want to see some screenshots first](https://github.com/programminghoch10/MobileIconChanger#screenshots)
head over to [the GitHub Repo](https://github.com/programminghoch10/MobileIconChanger).

# [MobileIconChanger](https://github.com/programminghoch10/MobileIconChanger)
更改您的移动数据图标！例如您可以将3G/4G图标更改为5G！

此模块使您能够将任何移动数据图标替换为任何其他移动数据图标。

## 兼容性

任何靠近 ROM 的 AOSP 都应该兼容。只需尝试一下，看看是否有效。 

[在此处阅读有关兼容性的更多信息](https://github.com/programminghoch10/MobileIconChanger#compatibility)。

## 安装

1. 在正在运行 API 版本“>=93”的 XPosed 框架的系统上安装该模块。
1. **激活 XPosed 框架管理器中的资源挂钩**。
1. 激活模块。应自动选择包“SystemUI”。
1. 重新启动手机。
1. 您现在可以使用该模块了。您需要打开[配置](#configuration)屏幕来进行所有设置，因为该模块还不会执行任何操作。

## 配置

_我不喜欢每个 XPosed 模块都向启动器添加另一个应用程序图标。这就是为什么此模块设置隐藏在应用程序信息屏幕中的原因。_

打开设置的方法如下：

- 路线 1：
    - 转到 XPosed 管理器中的模块列表
    - 长按“CameraControl”并选择“应用程序信息”
    - 在底部，单击“高级”
    - 单击“应用程序中的其他设置”
- 路线 2：
    - 进入设备设置
    - 单击应用程序
    - 以某种方式告诉设备显示所有应用程序
    - 选择“相机控制”
    - 在底部，单击“高级”
    - 单击“应用程序中的其他设置”
- 路线 3：
    - 打开 ADB shell
    - 运行命令“am start-activity com.programminghoch10.mobileicochanger/.SettingsActivity”

## 更多资源

我不想让 4 个不同的地方保持最新状态。

如果您想阅读更多有关 
[为什么这个模块存在](https://github.com/programminghoch10/MobileIconChanger#inspiration)
或[有关配置界面的其他信息](https://github.com/programminghoch10/MobileIconChanger#configuration)
或[您只想先看一些屏幕截图](https://github.com/programminghoch10/MobileIconChanger#screenshots)
前往 [GitHub 存储库](https://github.com/programminghoch10/MobileIconChanger)。
